create.title: Archive
create.name: Name:
create.levelHelp:
No compression — the files are just put together into one archive. Instant.
Fast — compresses a bit less, but quickly.
Normal — a balance of speed and size.
Maximum — the smallest archive, but slow.

Photos, videos, music and games (jpg, mp4, mp3, apk, nsp…) are already compressed and hardly get smaller — use “No compression” or “Fast” for them.
